name: c12d-substrate
description: step C12d: the substrate alone (one cell), the whole dish lit, a never-drying mineral spring (left) and vent (right), 6 min

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.clearSprings(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.42, v.cssH * 0.5, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.58, v.cssH * 0.5, 'heavy', 1e9); return moire.matter.springs.map(s => s.kind)
